notes: Reconciled from blind labelers A and B, who agree: 2 bends, [1,3] and [2,5]. This is a real two-skin scan, t~1.98 mm (twin skins 1.97-1.99 mm apart, stripe noise, plane rms 0.01-0.04 mm). The part is a flat base plate (1 top / 2 bottom, ~157 x 38 mm) with two round holes. A long flange (3 outer / 4 inner) is folded 90 deg toward the patch-2 side along the full long edge: ~10 mm outer height, ~6 mm flat. An end flange (5 outer / 6 inner) is folded 90 deg toward the patch-1 side across ~30 mm of one short end: ~20 mm outer height, ~18 mm flat. The reconciler checked 8 z-buffered global views, 18 end close-ups, 12 sections across fold 1, 12 across fold 2, and longitudinal and transverse base profiles. The base has only a smooth ~0.15 mm bow (no kink or joggle), and flanges 3 and 5 are planar (rms 0.019 / 0.012 mm). The small in-plane tab at the far short end, the corner chamfer and the diagonal flange-end relief are outline features. Hole walls and thickness edges are not bends. Each fold is marked once on its outer skin; [2,4] and [1,6] are the inner skins of the same folds.

bends.note: Long 90 deg flange fold along the full ~155 mm long edge (flange toward the patch-2 side). Outer skin is base top 1 plus flange outside 3. A radiused L was seen in sections from e1=-77 to +75.
End-flange 90 deg fold, ~30 mm long, at the short end (flange toward the patch-1 side). Outer skin is base underside 2 plus end-flange outside 5. A radiused L was seen in sections from e2=-19 to +9.
